remediation_backlog.title: Eliminate SQL Injection Vulnerabilities
remediation_backlog.problem_statement: Legacy VB6 code uses string concatenation for SQL queries, creating critical security vulnerabilities that must be resolved before modernization

remediation_backlog.risk_if_unaddressed: Race conditions in balance updates, lost transactions, regulatory compliance failures, inability to audit financial operations
remediation_backlog.suggested_approach: Implement database transactions with proper isolation levels, add optimistic concurrency control, create comprehensive audit logging for all balance changes

Concurrent deposit/withdrawal operations handled correctly
Complete audit trail for all financial operations
Compliance with banking regulatory requirements

provenance.evidence: UPDATE statement lacks transaction boundaries and concurrency control

team.name: Synthetix Modernization Team
team.description: Legacy modernization team focused on functional parity and migration safety.

1.persona: Prioritize legacy parity, interface contracts, backward compatibility, and modernization risk documentation.

2.persona: Sequence legacy modernization work into risk-aware sprints that preserve parity and unblock architecture design one sprint at a time.

3.persona: Map legacy flows to modern services while minimizing migration risk and preserving business behavior.

4.persona: Preserve brownfield screen behavior and event wiring while emitting scaffold-only frontend structure from Screen Contracts.

5.persona: Rewrite legacy logic with functional parity first, then improve modularity without changing behavior.

6.persona: Design low-risk schema/data migration scripts with rollback plans and validation checkpoints.

7.persona: Produce threat models, prioritized security controls, and release-gating recommendations.

8.persona: Run actionable checks, separate environment issues from code defects, and produce clear remediation guidance.

9.persona: Validate requirement coverage clearly for business stakeholders with traceable evidence.

10.persona: Prefer local Docker deployability, deterministic health checks, and clear run instructions.

delivery_constitution.modernization_objective: Modernize a VB6 banking workflow into a C# service-backed web application while preserving check balance and deposit behavior.
non_negotiables: Preserve legacy behavior first; any deviation requires explicit approval and tests.
Every major requirement/risk must be traceable to extracted evidence artifacts.
Do not change data contracts without migration and rollback plans.
Block planning when unresolved blockers exist (scope, IAM, schema-key, compliance).

orchestration_hints.reason: Preserve event behavior and control wiring parity.

orchestration_hints.reason: Force citation-backed remediation and blocking decisions.

pre_change: Confirm scope variant/project decision is recorded.
Verify source snapshot and context bundle IDs are pinned.
Review top blocking risks and required decisions before planning.
post_change: Re-run QA structural and semantic gates.
Update delivery docs/artifacts for any changed behavior assumptions.

findings.title: Hotspot: authentication_authorization
findings.description: No visible authentication or authorization mechanisms

findings.title: Critical SQL Injection Vulnerability
findings.description: Legacy VB6 code uses direct string concatenation for SQL queries, allowing arbitrary SQL execution through user input fields

findings.title: Data Contract Preservation Risk
findings.description: Migration from VB6 ADO Recordset to C# may introduce behavioral changes in balance calculations and transaction handling

findings.title: Banking Compliance Gap
findings.description: No visible audit trails, transaction logging, or compliance controls for financial operations

findings.title: Concurrent Access Control
findings.description: Legacy code shows no concurrency control for balance updates, risking race conditions in multi-user scenarios

backlog.title: Eliminate SQL Injection Vulnerabilities
backlog.business_value: Complete database compromise, unauthorized balance modifications, regulatory violations, potential financial fraud
plan: Replace string concatenation with parameterized queries using Entity Framework or Dapper in C# implementation
acceptance_criteria: All SQL queries use parameterized statements
Static analysis confirms no string concatenation in database queries
Penetration testing validates SQL injection prevention

backlog.title: Implement Banking Transaction Controls
backlog.business_value: Race conditions in balance updates, lost transactions, regulatory compliance failures, inability to audit financial operations
plan: Implement database transactions with proper isolation levels, add optimistic concurrency control, create comprehensive audit logging for all balance changes
acceptance_criteria: All balance operations wrapped in database transactions
Complete audit trail for all financial operations

backlog.title: Design Data Migration Strategy
backlog.business_value: Data loss during migration, behavioral regressions, extended downtime, inability to rollback if issues occur
plan: Create comprehensive mapping between VB6 ADO patterns and C# Entity Framework, implement side-by-side testing, develop rollback procedures
acceptance_criteria: 100% functional parity between VB6 and C# implementations
Performance benchmarks meet or exceed legacy system

backlog.title: Implement Authentication and Authorization
backlog.business_value: Unauthorized access to banking functions, regulatory compliance violations, potential financial fraud
plan: Implement OAuth2/OpenID Connect with role-based access control, integrate with existing bank identity systems, add session management
acceptance_criteria: Role-based access control for banking operations
Integration with bank's identity management system
